description: How long a piece of work may sit in one state before someone is told. The state machines say what may happen next; none of them says anything about how long the wait may be, so a perfectly correct workflow can stall indefinitely and still be correct.
what_this_is_not: Not a scheduler. Claude Code has no persistent background process this plugin can rely on, so nothing here fires by itself. scripts/check_liveness.py answers 'what is stuck' when it is run: from a session, from CI, or from whatever timer the project already has. Claiming otherwise would be a watchdog that does not watch.
clock: Wall-clock hours since the artifact's updated_at. Deliberately not business hours: the organization is agents, which do not keep office hours, and a human threshold long enough to survive a weekend is set here as hours rather than inferred from a calendar this plugin does not have.

ladder.means: The department lead that owns the cycle. Most staleness is a lead's to resolve.
The department head. Reached when the lead has had time and it is still stuck.
A named human. Reached only for decisions no agent may take, or when the organization has had long enough that silence is itself the problem.

in-review.why: A review that has not concluded in a working day is usually waiting on something nobody has said out loud.

draft.why: A draft nobody has touched in a day is either finished or abandoned, and both need saying.

blocked.why: Two days blocked means the blocker is outside the organization's power to clear.

open.why: Applies to defects and incidents that were opened and then went quiet.

CHANGES_REQUESTED.why: Rework that has not restarted is rework that is not happening.

LEAD_REVIEW.why: The lead is the one holding it, so the lead is not who to tell.

ACCEPTANCE_REQUESTED.why: Acceptance is a machine evaluation. Waiting hours for it means nobody ran it.

ESCALATED.why: An escalation is a request for a decision. Unanswered, it is worse than the problem that raised it.

open_decision.why: A DEC exists because an agent refused to guess. Leaving it open turns that refusal into the delay it was meant to prevent.

blocking_decision_why: A decision marked blocking halves every threshold above. Work is stopped behind it, which is a different kind of waiting from a question that can be answered later.
project_override: A project may replace any threshold in .ai-engineering/project.yaml under sla. Nothing here can know a given team's tolerance for a slow review.
